newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster names chief financial officer.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Monday it named Steven Preston as senior vice president and chief financial officer.
He replaces Ernie Mrozek, who was recently named president and chief operating officer of ServiceMaster's consumer services segment, a spokeswoman said.
Preston had been senior vice president and treasurer at First Data Corp, ServiceMaster said. Previously, he was an investment banker at Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc.

"Steve Preston has an excellent background in investment banking, capital markets, financing, strategic planning, and acquisitions," Carlos Cantu, president, said in a statement. "As ServiceMaster continues its rapid expansion, Steve's experience managing financial strategy at a fast-growing company will be particularly beneficial to us."

ServiceMaster is a network of service companies with two major operating segments, ServiceMaster Consumer Services and ServiceMaster Management Services, and two emerging units, ServiceMaster Diversified Health Services and International.
